fee_notes: Royalty min is $650/month per territory (1 territory=$650, 2=$1300, etc.), waived first 6 months. Marketing fund is greater of 2% or $162.50/territory/month. Tech fee currently $250/month, cap $500/month. Additional local marketing requirement: $1,000/month for first territory plus $500/month per additional territory.
